park_permit.name: Conservation / National Park Entry
park_permit.details: The Shey Phoksundo National Park Permit is required for all visitors trekking in the Shey Phoksundo National Park, located in the Dolpa district of western Nepal. Established in 1984, it is Nepal’s largest national park, renowned for its pristine lakes—like the sacred Phoksundo Lake—high-altitude landscapes, and unique wildlife including snow leopards, musk deer, and blue sheep. This permit helps conserve the fragile ecosystem and supports local communities living inside the park. It is valid for single entry and must be obtained before entering the park.
